title: Co-Creation Accelerator 2026-2027
fit_reason: This is a startup accelerator program seeking deep tech ventures as applicants (not consultants), but DevelopMinded could support eligible client startups in preparing and submitting their applications to this EIT Digital co-creation program.
call_summary: The Co-Creation Accelerator 2026-2027 is an EIT Digital (28DIGITAL) program offering up to €250,000 in equity-based funding for early-stage digital startups (TRL 4-5+) to co-develop solutions with industry partners over 4 months. Contractors/applicants must be micro or small enterprises incorporated within the last 5 years in an EU/HE country, and must deliver a co-created solution addressing a defined industry challenge.

title: The Request for Proposals for a qualified supplier to act as the EIT Community Officer (ECO) for the EIT Community Hub in Serbia
fit_reason: This tender requires a Serbia-based legally registered entity to act as an on-the-ground EIT Community Hub coordinator, which is a local operational role rather than a strategic commercialisation or consultancy engagement — though DevelopMinded's partnership strategy, stakeholder outreach, and innovation ecosystem experience are partially relevant.
call_summary: This RfP seeks a qualified supplier physically based in Serbia to serve as the EIT Community Officer for the EIT Community Hub in Serbia from August 2026 to December 2027, acting as the central coordination point for all nine EIT KICs. The contractor must implement joint EIT Community activities, engage local stakeholders, foster synergies between KICs, and maximise innovation uptake and community outreach in Serbia.

title: The Request for Proposals for a qualified supplier to act as the EIT Community Officer (ECO) for the EIT Community Hub in Estonia
fit_reason: This tender requires a locally registered Estonian entity to act as an EIT Community Hub operational coordinator, which is a staffing/representation role rather than DevelopMinded's core consultancy services, though there is partial overlap in stakeholder engagement and innovation ecosystem work.
call_summary: This call seeks a qualified supplier physically based in Estonia to serve as the EIT Community Officer (ECO), acting as the central coordination and operational point for all nine EIT KIC activities in Estonia from August 2026 to December 2027. The contractor must implement joint innovation activities, engage local stakeholders, foster synergies between EIT KICs, and act as a one-stop shop for EIT Community presence in Estonia.

title: Pio Tool It Support And Developments 26 28
fit_reason: This tender requires a Microsoft SharePoint and PowerApps technical IT development provider, which is entirely outside DevelopMinded's technology commercialisation and strategic consultancy services.
call_summary: EIT Urban Mobility is seeking a qualified IT supplier to provide technical support, maintenance, and development services for their internal PIO Tool environment, built on Microsoft SharePoint, PowerApps, Power BI, Adobe Sign, and the EIT Community Portal. The contractor must deliver hands-on IT development and ongoing technical maintenance of these Microsoft-based platforms.

title: Provision Of Mobile Phone Services And Devices 26 28
fit_reason: This tender is for a mobile phone and telecommunications services provider, which is entirely unrelated to DevelopMinded's technology commercialisation and strategic consultancy services.
call_summary: EIT Urban Mobility is procuring mobile network and internet services across European countries for the period 2026-2028. The contractor must provide mobile phone services and devices as a telecommunications operator.

title: Request for Proposal: Lithium Value Chain Study: EU Supply–Demand Gap and Strategic Project…
fit_reason: This tender requires deep commodity market research and geopolitical supply chain analysis for lithium, which is far outside DevelopMinded's core services in technology commercialisation, investment readiness, and startup/spinout support.
call_summary: EIT RawMaterials is commissioning a comprehensive study on the EU lithium value chain, covering supply-demand gaps, end-use sector analysis (batteries, EVs, ESS, etc.), and identification of strategic investment projects outside the EU. The contractor must deliver an integrated global overview of the lithium value chain with quantitative demand/supply projections and prioritised third-country project recommendations to guide EU Delegations.
